earthViews.observed: Pyramid east face and Sphinx arrival: long low forecourt statue, white flat roofs, two stepped bronze wings, west parking and pools.

North two towers with pale flat roofs, open tall rectangular colonnades in side courts, low central north lobby roof and covered bridge to Excalibur, small raised roof lights behind lobby. The central low roof is not the same height as tower base portions of mapped podium.
Southwest service block has two stepped roof heights and roof equipment; Mandalay Place foreground belongs to a different owner.
Sphinx cream body, long paws, blue/gold nemes, crown and small face. Tram structure crosses arrival.
Enclosed elevated connector crosses north service road and meets low central lobby. Side courts have tall open colonnades.

Topdown pool enclosure: northern stepped rectangular basin, larger irregular pool wrapping central octagonal pavilion and under elevated parking walkway, round lobe northeast, northwestern service plant with fan banks.
